feature: Complete supplier timber delivery into physical warehouse storage
user_outcome: Two actual workers unload one real timber bundle, shoulder-carry it together and visibly deposit it into the warehouse; the truck departs safely and another order can be placed.

existing_owners.custody: IdentityLedger.joint_carries: begin/move/finish/put_down keep one physical stock identity and two exclusive worker commitments
existing_owners.scheduling: Receiving and Freight event boundaries; no added global clock, repeating scheduler or animation stock callbacks
existing_owners.storage: WarehouseService reserves one finite existing timber cell before cargo leaves the truck
existing_owners.geometry: Existing paired_ground_path checks the complete fixed-orientation worker/load envelope; authored turns require actual clear staging space
existing_owners.art: Artist Director owns new anatomical contacts, continuous motion, verified exports and normal-speed appearance review; Lead owns integration

first_independent_increment.change: Adopt the already delivered separate warehouse long-stock v04 model and timber-only .60/1.75m cell planes; preserve original rack and crate handling.
first_independent_increment.collision: Reuse cached exact static mesh collision, so the authored openings are not filled by old coarse boxes.
first_independent_increment.startup: Include revised fixture in existing loading-cover preparation and declared remote import dependencies.
first_independent_increment.check: One brief GitHub current-change observation of the revised timber-only fixture, four cell registrations and preserved ordinary crate planes. Retrieve the actual generated import sidecar; no local engine.
first_independent_increment.not_complete: This is not a finished animated paired delivery. Do not bind historical rejected clips or remove the current honest timber hold until the shared action and accepted motion are connected.

check_result.scope: Actual revised import/bounds, four timber cells, unchanged crate cells and exact mesh collision; no paired motion

pair_action_contract: Respect the shared hauling priority selector; never borrow a busy worker, consume a higher-priority commitment, or strand one waiting worker instead of feasible lower-priority work.
Select two distinct eligible physically available hauling workers; reserve both exclusively before claiming one <=50kg source package and one warehouse cell.
No second eligible person, warehouse cell, truck aisle or complete swept route means cargo stays aboard with a specific event-woken reason.
Prepare a missing compatible fixture through a real worker visit and existing smoke lifecycle before access.

Keep fore/aft roles attached to the same worker identities. Actual pickup stations, start/stop/turn/ramp/put-down paths and grip release come from the accepted export metadata, never guessed legacy sockets.
Use one shared custody begin, atomic pair/payload motion, and one actual destination finish/warehouse commit. Both workers retain their original 25kg contribution limits.

Reassignment/return before lift releases uncollected promises safely. After lift finish the real supported deposit or existing recoverable put-down; never delete or duplicate cargo. A ground put-down does not commit a warehouse cell, count supplier return, refund cargo, or complete the physical delivery gate; it needs an actual recovery route.
Pause freezes committed progress and active cosmetics. Hidden views keep applicable domain progression and stop cosmetic frame processing.
Return/departure still waits for actual handlers, cargo and shelf/ramp/door clearance. Convoy readiness follows the existing final physical handover/departure rules.

designer_scope_review.decision: Observable plan accepted with hauling-priority and recoverable-put-down accounting clarifications incorporated above; final connected-head and animation acceptance remain separate.
designer_scope_review.source: Direct Designer response to this Lead plan in the current task on 13 November 2026

required_artist_handoff: Approved shoulder/stabilizer contact frames and continuous actual-worker video
Source/export hashes, clip windows and floor-root/payload transforms
Truck pickup/ramp and warehouse lower/upper face transitions fitted to accepted unchanged assets
No hand/torso or glove/load penetration, no excessive ramp bounce, stable fore/aft identity
verification_policy: Only brief changed-action checks on GitHub. No local Godot, regression suites, raised performance limits or broad FPS acceptance. Human appearance review is distinct from Lead/Designer PR decisions.

next_independent_increment.change: Adopt delivered S1v03 ONLY for timber racks, matching .60/.95m truck-floor support planes and explicit bundle base registration. Preserve metal S1 legacy geometry/packing and existing vehicle/cargo envelopes.

next_independent_increment.transform: Use existing measured Cargo_Floor-to-rack placement once; no new recentering or truck geometry edit.
next_independent_increment.startup_and_check: Declare actual model import and existing loading-cover preparation, then one bounded exact-variant/actual-render-model current-change demonstration on GitHub. Keep rejected motion unbound.
